verdict.rationale: Gladia has no native rules engine. Its docs do list official integration partners for no-code and workflow automation (Zapier, Make, n8n), so event-triggered automation is possible, but the rules are defined in those third-party platforms rather than in Gladia itself. The evidence is only a one-line listing per integration. Missing for 10: a native rule or trigger definition capability in Gladia, documented events and triggers exposed to automations, documented outbound webhooks/callbacks, and any hands-on or independent corroboration.
